remarks: FINAL AND BEST DUE FRIDAY SEPT 6, 2024, by 5PM. Welcome Home! This beautifully updated end-unit in Rowayton Woods is a 1-bedroom, 1-bath charmer! Bright and airy, the dining room is enhanced by corner windows, and the kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, with an update completed in 2019. Lutron lighting graces the living, dining, and bedroom areas, creating a modern and inviting atmosphere. Enjoy all that Rowayton Woods has, including a stunning pool complex, tennis court, a peaceful community garden by the pond, walking trails, and a convenient walking bridge leading to access to the Rowayton train station. Just over two miles away, you'll find Trader Joe's and other shopping options. Don't miss the opportunity to own a home in this fantastic and conveniently located complex!
